source.prompt: How do I track leads that come in through WhatsApp in a CRM?
source.note: real collected answer; brand, competitors and publishers are the specs the cycle was scored with

answer.text:
Tracking WhatsApp leads in a CRM usually requires connecting WhatsApp to your CRM so every conversation becomes a trackable lead record rather than staying trapped in an individual phone app. A typical setup looks like this:

### 1. Use an official WhatsApp business connection
Use the urlWhatsApp Business Platformhttps://business.whatsapp.com/products/platform (often through a provider) rather than a personal WhatsApp number. This lets you capture messages, automate workflows, and connect to CRM systems.

Common connection providers include:
- urlTwilio WhatsApp APIhttps://www.twilio.com/whatsapp
- url360dialog WhatsApp APIhttps://www.360dialog.com/whatsapp-business-platform/
- urlWATI WhatsApp API Platformhttps://www.wati.io/

### 2. Create a lead record automatically
When someone messages your WhatsApp number, your integration should:

1. Create or find a CRM contact
2. Store:
   - Name (if available)
   - Phone number
   - WhatsApp conversation history
   - Lead source = "WhatsApp"
   - Campaign/source details (if known)
   - Date/time of first contact
3. Assign the lead to a salesperson or queue

Example:

> New WhatsApp message → CRM creates Lead #10452 → Source: WhatsApp → Assigned to Sales Rep A → Follow-up task created

### 3. Add lead source tracking
Don't just use "WhatsApp" as the source. Add more detail:

| Field | Example |
|---|---|
| Lead Source | WhatsApp |
| Campaign | Summer Promo |
| Entry Point | Facebook Ad |
| Product Interest | Kitchen Remodel |
| First Response Time | 4 minutes |
| Status | New / Qualified / Won |

For ads, use WhatsApp links with tracking parameters so you know where the conversation originated.

### 4. Sync conversations into the CRM
Depending on your CRM, you can:
- Attach WhatsApp chats to the contact record
- Allow reps to reply from the CRM inbox
- Search old conversations
- Measure response times

Popular CRMs with WhatsApp integrations include:
- urlSalesforcehttps://www.salesforce.com (usually via partners or AppExchange integrations)
- urlHubSpothttps://www.hubspot.com
- urlZoho CRMhttps://www.zoho.com/crm/
- urlPipedrivehttps://www.pipedrive.com

### 5. Set up automation
Useful workflows:

**New WhatsApp lead**
→ Create contact  
→ Send acknowledgment message  
→ Notify sales rep  
→ Create follow-up task

**No response after 24 hours**
→ Reminder task

**Qualified lead**
→ Move pipeline stage  
→ Schedule call/demo

**Lost lead**
→ Add reason and future follow-up date

### 6. Measure WhatsApp performance
Track metrics such as:
- Number of WhatsApp leads
- Lead-to-opportunity conversion rate
- Average response time
- Sales generated from WhatsApp
- Which campaigns generate WhatsApp conversations
- Rep response performance

A simple architecture is:

**WhatsApp → WhatsApp API provider → CRM → Automation → Sales team → Reporting**

If you tell me which CRM you use (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Pipedrive, etc.) and whether leads come from ads, your website, or direct messages, I can outline the exact setup.
